newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle active at $66, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle active at $66, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers fully $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Inquiry and demand was strong.
Sales confirmed on 15,800 slaughter steers and 14,200 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 102,300 head confirmed including 19,400 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 66.00, couple pens 65.00-65.50.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 980-1150 lbs 66.00, pen 65.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1050 lb heifers and heiferettes 64.50.
Wk to date - 102,300 last week- 109,900 last year - 68,900
